skills.name: architect

skills.name: how

skills.name: maintain-verification-skill

skills.name: make-bot-ui
skills.rationale: No runnable skill ships: the source is a Cursor/Grok Bot routine coupled to secret-card APIs, a cursor.sh webhook endpoint, and automatic sudo/Tailscale installation. Use architect to design a reviewed, least-privilege manual bot UI for the target environment.
skills.safe_alternative: Use the architect skill to design a manual, reviewed, least-privilege bot UI for the actual target environment.
